faqs.q: Sec. 54-157. - Payment of parking fee required.
faqs.a:
(a)
It shall be unlawful for any person to park a vehicle in any parking space on a lot,
               garage, or on a public street that requires payment as a condition of using said space,
               as indicated by official signs without depositing the required fee at the time of
               parking, or without undertaking the required alternative payment process for parking
               locations applicable to such space with alternative payment capability, for the time
               used, during the applicable hours of operation, and on the applicable days of operation
               of such parking location.
(b)
No vehicle shall remain in a space regulated by a paid parking system station for
               longer than the maximum time that can be purchased from the system at one time, except
               during those times and dates indicated for which payment is not required.
(
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
